pyramiding_rule: No pyramiding into positions unless the initial trade has moved at least 1.5x the ATR in profit and trailing stop is locked at break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require volumetric delta confirmation and spread validation to ensure entry is outside immediate high-frequency stop-hunting bands.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and trail the remainder dynamically using parabolic SAR or 5-period EMA.
